behavior_contract.mutation_behavior: Pure function; does not mutate input; no side effects

normalization_specification: Normalization (such as case folding, whitespace stripping, or punctuation removal) is NOT part of this function. Characters are compared directly and strictly at each position (string[left] !== string[right]) without pre-processing.

decisive_state_transition.overview: Two pointers left = 0 and right = string.length - 1 contract towards the center. At each step, equality string[left] === string[right] is evaluated.
decisive_state_transition.mismatch_transition: If string[left] !== string[right], a mismatch is decisively established, immediately returning false without scanning remaining characters.
decisive_state_transition.convergence_transition: When left >= right, all symmetrical pairs have verified equal without mismatch, decisively establishing palindrome symmetry and returning true.

fixtures_and_traced_execution.decisive_transition: Loop condition (0 < -1) is false; loop skipped
fixtures_and_traced_execution.test: returns true for the empty string fixture ("")

fixtures_and_traced_execution.decisive_transition: Pointers meet at index 0 (0 < 0 is false); loop skipped
fixtures_and_traced_execution.test: returns true for single character fixture ("a")

fixtures_and_traced_execution.decisive_transition: Pointers converge at middle index 1 (1 < 1 is false)
fixtures_and_traced_execution.test: returns true for odd-length palindrome fixture ("aba")

Pointers cross (2 < 1 is false); all symmetrical pairs matched
